core-ship.does: ship the task in the payload: branch, code, changeset, gate in session, draft PR, comments on the issue

core-land.does: review, fix, gate on merged head, merge commit, retro, issue Done; never the Version Packages PR

golf-ship.does: ship the task in the payload against stage: branch, code, lefthook pre-push gate in session, draft PR, comments on the issue

golf-land.does: review, fix, gate on the merged head, merge commit into stage, retro, issue Done; never stage→main

marketplace-ship.does: add or edit a skill, bump the plugin + marketplace version pair, open and self-merge the PR (docs-only repo, no CI)
